agent_assumptions: No elevation or other floor supplied: z_floor=0 and ceiling_height=3.0 m are explicit assumptions.
Door heights 0-2.1 m and window sill/head 0.9-2.1 m are conventional assumptions, unobserved in the plan.
Room roles inferred from furniture (desks, meeting table); no text labels observed.
Interior partitions/corridor walls drawn ~120 mm double-line; representative centrelines used (zero-thickness compiler lines).
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
unresolved: Door leaf swing directions observed but operating states unknown (default unknown).
Exact corridor wall nominal thickness ambiguous (drawn ~120 mm; adjacent chain labels 250/340 describe door margins, not thickness).
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

plan_compilation.basis: Calibration from original dimension chains (profile_001/002/014): top chain tick centres x=428..1818 px = 15000 mm outer faces; left chain y=346..1087 px = 8000 mm outer faces. Scale 0.0107914 m/px, verified against right chain (corridor wall faces y=618/629 and 804/815 px = world 5.0/3.0 m bands; east window jambs 661/772 px = 3.4-4.6 m). Footprint uses observed OUTER wall faces (240 mm exterior walls drawn 346-368 etc.); interior dividers use measured two-face centrelines: partitions drawn as 11-px double lines at x=883/894 and 1346/1358 (centreline 888.5/1352, ~120 mm), corridor walls at y=618-629 and 804-815 (centreline 623.5/809.5, ~120 mm drawn, chain-side labels suggest nominal 120-250 bands). Corridor is one continuous open space y=3.0-5.0 m full width.
